title: L1 recursive kinship DNA exposure policy

policy.selection_rule: Classify by membership in recursivePool() reading set; choose recursive with min(natural_share, 0.25), otherwise choose non-recursive.

rationale: The recursive kinship grammar is productive and grammatical, so deletion would discard useful structure.
At 47.9% of the unique L1 DNA-button reading pool it disproportionately defines the app's voice.
A 25% cap keeps the family discoverable while roughly doubling the chance of seeing a non-kinship DNA mechanism.
This mirrors the v0.70 bridge strategy: control exposure separately from corpus size.
invariants: recursivePool() remains available to candidate counting and future explicit tools.
If recursive or nonrecursive pool is empty, use the non-empty pool.
Global seen-reading behavior remains in effect.
next_step: Integrate only into dnaOne(), validate that dnaPool(true) inventory remains unchanged, then audit 10-item comparison separately.
